svg.title: Two-site DMRG
svg.desc: The effective Hamiltonian and two-site DMRG update from Fig. 8(b–c) of Hauschild and Pollmann (2018), including local optimization and the SVD step. Fig. 8(b–c) from Johannes Hauschild and Frank Pollmann, Efficient numerical simulations with Tensor Networks: Tensor Network Python (TeNPy), SciPost Physics Lecture Notes 5 (2018). https://doi.org/10.21468/SciPostPhysLectNotes.5. CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Panels cropped from the original vector PDF. Diagram, arrows, and notation retained; lettering converted to SVG paths.
